_doc: SQL command pools for database_maintenance tickets. Each entry is [statement, is_destructive_flag].
readonly: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day';
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM payments WHERE id = 12345;
ddl: ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN preferred_channel VARCHAR(32);
destructive: DELETE FROM customers WHERE last_seen < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 years';
UPDATE orders SET status = 'archived' WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days';
mass_export: COPY (SELECT id, name, email, dob, ssn FROM customers) TO '/tmp/customers.csv' WITH CSV HEADER;
